about.arch.title: From a citizen's message to a funded, verified fix
about.badge: Built as a Digital Public Good
about.p.equity.body: An equity audit checks whether vulnerable areas are actually funded, and the budget planner can reserve a guaranteed share for them.
about.p.equity.title: Fairness is measured
about.p.explain.body: Every priority score shows its inputs, weights and any data it had to substitute, so an official can defend a ranking to a secretary or a journalist.
about.p.explain.title: Explainable, never a black box
about.p.ground.body: The policy co-pilot answers only from real tool calls. Numbers it cannot trace to data are removed, and questions without data are refused.
about.p.ground.title: Grounded AI or no answer
about.p.lang.body: Eleven languages, voice in and voice out, WhatsApp and SMS. Adding a language is a translation file.
about.p.lang.title: Language is not a barrier
about.p.loop.body: A fix only counts when citizens confirm it and an officer signs it off. Real results feed back into future scores.
about.p.loop.title: The loop is closed
about.p.privacy.body: Phone numbers are hashed, personal details are scrubbed before AI sees them, public numbers are k-anonymous, and citizens can export or erase their data.
about.p.privacy.title: Privacy by design
about.pillars.title: Design principles
about.road.1: A voice-only phone line for people with no data connection.
about.road.2: Learned ranking from real scheme outcomes, replacing hand-tuned weights.
about.road.3: A national aggregation layer over state-level deployments.
about.road.4: Optional identity checks for high-trust reports through India Stack.
about.road.title: Where it goes next
about.stack.note: Runs entirely on free tiers for a pilot, and on Cloud Run, Firestore and BigQuery when a state needs scale. The same code serves both.
about.stack.title: Built with
about.subtitle: A single codebase that turns what citizens say into ranked, explainable, fundable priorities, and then proves whether the money worked.
about.title: How Pramaan works

landing.fund.body: The gap this closes is between what people report and the central schemes that could pay for the fix. Pramaan shows officials which programme fits each issue, and how much of the cost the centre would carry.
landing.fund.note: Indicative sharing patterns from published scheme guidelines. Officers confirm against current rules before committing funds.

landing.gap1.body: The same pothole is reported ten ways, in five languages, through five channels.
landing.gap1.title: Fragmented
landing.gap2.body: Budgets follow habit, not evidence of need, vulnerability or past funding.
landing.gap2.title: Misaligned
landing.gap3.body: There is rarely proof that a fix happened, or that citizens felt it.
landing.gap3.title: Unmeasured
landing.how.title: From a citizen's words to a funded, verified fix
landing.liveEmpty: Numbers appear once enough reports have been received.
landing.problem.body: Development requests sit in fragmented systems. Spending drifts away from real need, gaps go unaddressed, and nobody can measure whether a large investment actually helped.
landing.problem.title: Citizen feedback and public spending never meet.
landing.scale.body: Adding a state or a country is configuration, not a rewrite. Brazil already runs on the same code as proof.

landing.score.body: Every score shows its inputs, weights and any data it had to substitute. No black box: a policymaker, a journalist or a citizen can see exactly why a ward ranks where it does.
